item.title: SFC Extends Digital Asset Trading to Professional Financing and Investment Products
item.description: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) issued a guidance extending virtual asset (VA) services to margin financing for licensed brokers providing VA dealing services (VA brokers). item.title: Sumsub Warns That Identity Fraud Is Becoming Sharper and Better Planned
item.description: The global rate of identity fraud decreased in 2025 from the previous year’s high, but the threats have become more severe. Fraud isn’t retreating, it’s maturing.
